newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Goh claims victory ahead of polls.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Goh claims victory ahead of polls.

text.p: Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong claimed victory on Monday ahead of elections whose date was expected to be announced later in the day.

"We are already in government," he told reporters shortly after nominations closed. Goh said his People's Action Party (PAP) had won 47 seats in the 83-member parliament because no opposition candidates had entered the races.
"The opposition have conceded by them not contesting" the 47 seats, he said.
"They have no alternative to the PAP's vision, its programmes and ideas. They have accepted that the PAP has the mandate."
The Election Commission was due to announce a polling date later on Monday. Most analysts expect voting to be held in the first week of January.
